environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 with a custom AppArmor profile 'docproc-confined' loaded in enforce mode. The profile specifies: deny /** w (global write deny), allow /var/lib/docproc/scratch/** rwk (restricted scratch space), allow /proc/self/** r, allow /usr/share/dotnet/** rix. The profile uses 'owner' conditional on the scratch path requiring the process UID to match file owner. Additionally, the scratch directory /var/lib/docproc/scratch/ is mounted as a separate ext4 partition with nosuid,nodev,noexec mount options and has fs.protected_symlinks=1 set via sysctl. Note: the UPLOAD_DIR environment variable is set to /var/lib/docproc/scratch but the path traversal in file.FileName could still construct paths outside this directory.
